seed_policy: single seed per new configuration; seed0 except instability retry reuses failed seed1
prerequisites: E57 stopped and wide seed1 health audited

wide_repair.conditional: wide seed1 numerical collapse or repeated explosive instability

large.input_engine: CPU cache with batch staging; verify before launch

candidate_scale: one pretraining fixed kappa = mean original-overlap output-state gradient norm / mean centerline-overlap output-state gradient norm, frozen E42 outputs on same five train members; no dev tuning; freeze identical in all phases
selection_rules: README.md predeclared conservative common-metric gate; no total-Loss comparison across definitions
monitor: unchanged train500/dev500; each run fixed objective for optimization/monitoring/best/LR/early stop
finalization_each: one own-Loss best -> raw dev2000 and shared metrics -> one flash500 -> fixed same100 no-rating gallery
